correctness.rationale: Every Zimin palindrome is exactly an integer interval corresponding to a forward Gray-cube edge; proof includes converse and 2-adic center bound. All minimum hypercube paths flip target bits once. Index monotonicity is equivalent to an even number of previously chosen greater bit positions, so deleting the last choice gives the exact recurrence and factorial solution. Literal-palindrome dynamic programming checks prefixes 0..500.
